evaluation_note: Each condition is evaluated independently and EVERY condition that fires is named in `matched`. A queue entry that says only 'needs review' is a usability defect -- the reviewer cannot tell whether to distrust the model, the microphone or the class definition. Conditions are listed in the order the queue sorts equal-priority items.

conditions.srs_phrase: Different predictions from the two models
conditions.reason_template: The Python model predicted '{python_class}' ({python_confidence:.2f}) and the GTM model predicted '{gtm_class}' ({gtm_confidence:.2f}).
conditions.recommended_action: Listen to the segment and decide which model is correct before either result is trusted.

conditions.reason_template: At least one model is below the low-confidence band ({low_confidence_band:.2f}): Python {python_confidence:.2f}, GTM {gtm_confidence:.2f}.
conditions.recommended_action: Confirm the class by listening; consider whether the segment contains an event at all.
Re-upload a cleaner recording if the event matters; a Poor segment cannot support a confident decision either way.

conditions.reason_template: The top two classes are within the configured margin ({margin:.2f} < {margin_min:.2f}), so the leading class is close to a coin toss.
conditions.recommended_action: Treat the leading two classes as equally likely and check whether the segment contains both events.

conditions.reason_template: A second class ('{secondary_detection}') also reached the overlap threshold, so more than one event may be present.
conditions.recommended_action: A single stored label cannot describe two simultaneous events -- decide whether a second event should be recorded.

conditions.reason_template: The segment does not match any of the ten supported classes reliably.
conditions.recommended_action: FR li: mark as Unknown or Manual Review Required rather than forcing one of the ten classes.

conditions.srs_phrase: Critical event without sufficient model agreement
conditions.reason_template: A critical category ('{predicted_class}') was detected without sufficient model agreement ({consistency_status}).
conditions.recommended_action: Review immediately: raise the alert only if the event is confirmed, because a missed critical event and a false critical alert are both expensive.

conditions.reason_template: A critical category ('{predicted_class}') was raised on weak evidence: quality '{quality}', top-two margin {margin:.2f}, confidence difference {confidence_difference:.2f}.
conditions.recommended_action: Verify before dispatch. Record the outcome so the false-positive and false-negative analytics stay honest.

never_auto_review.note: Conditions that must NOT, on their own, push a clean result into the queue. An explicit denial is easier to audit than an omission.
rules: a critical class with Strong Match and Good quality
a Background Noise result below the ambient level limit
